panels.text: 07/09/26 All CUBE repos have been migrated to GHE and pipelines relinked to use GHE. Kodex migration has been completed. The majority of Acin repos have been migrated, 60 are outstanding, pipeline migration is to be completed. 4CRisk repos have had secrets addressed. Large files and restricted file types are outstanding. Releases for Red Bull and HSBC is being prioritised with GitHub migration work expected to recommence during the week of 07/09. The Golden Pipeline and AI Skills have been created documented. Engineering Managers are being engaged to work on pipeline migration with support from the team. Blocking of Critical security vulnerabilities is scheduled to be enabled 16/09.

07/09/26    Dev and Test environments are provisioned and live in Azure. Prod is planned to be staged through September. Provisioning of SQL MI for Content was discussed 07/09. Dev and Test will be created first with the data being backed up and restored from on prem to Azure. Prod will use SQL MI Link and on prem servers need to be upgraded to have SQL compatible with MI Link.

panels.text: 19/08/26 ProtonVPN has been onboarded. Additional proxies can be set up using ProtonVPN, the process has been defined where the research team create tickets for provisioning.
